Major AI Developments.title: Haryana Assembly | Saini slams IYC’s ‘shirtless protest’; state highlights AI hubs, farmer relief, infra push
Major AI Developments.summary: Haryana Assembly discussed various topics, including criticism of the Indian Youth Congress's 'shirtless protest' by Saini. The state also highlighted its initiatives, such as developing AI hubs and providing relief to farmers. Additionally, the state emphasized its focus on infrastructure development.
